rites.name: Oriareontum
rites.text: Oriareontum is the concept of the first sounding in Eleirenora, the note that pulled the scattered roots of the world into a single condensing knot. It is less a being than a pattern of resonance that still hums faintly in the deepest stone of the Arcane Realm.

rites.name: Corestanum
rites.text: A tracked projectile is hurled skyward and then trails the drifting balloons below. It pops them one by one and falls at the center, starting a chain of bursts that clears the field.

rites.name: Siallum
rites.text: A dread-laden charm that a single bearer can call forth to weaken an opposing fighter's strike for the span of one full round. It is bought with a single coin of gold.

rites.name: Senteonus
rites.text: A focus setting held by one particular beekeeper once he reaches a certain rank. Activating it halts his own stinging and directs the hive toward crafting a sweet nectar that restores vitality at regular intervals.

rites.name: Orarniantum
rites.text: A tempering practice that quickens the recovery of the highest-tier arts a warrior has mastered. Each use shortens the wait before those great workings can be called again, and it requires no prior training to begin.

rites.name: Amauntor
rites.text: A glacial crust forms over certain orbs when a frost-bearing agent touches them. The crust blocks sharp strikes while letting blunt, fiery, and other forces pass through unchanged.

rites.name: Oreoliantes
rites.text: A fiery sweep of five flame bursts fanned in a curve, blasting clumps of unshielded foes. It is the fourth refinement of a sorcerer's arm-bound craft.

rites.name: Leontiasus
rites.text: A temple-taught discipline that lets every bearer strike the pale shells of the frozen. Its binding makes stilled foes linger longer under the chill, and blows of nearly any kind can break the ice.

rites.name: Valaria
rites.text: A cold binding that slows the foes struck by a line of shots. Chains of quick hits send out frozen shards that stall enemies behind the target, though the largest brutes resist its chill.

rites.name: Orauntarnum
rites.text: A rare charm that instantly locks every ordinary foe in place for a short while, though the strongest brutes resist its chill. It can only be invoked again after a lengthy rest.

rites.name: Tornum
rites.text: A rare summoning craft that calls forth blazing hunting beasts. They strike harder than their common kin, but cannot harm the violet foes, while they can break frozen and leaden targets.

rites.name: Conarnes
rites.text: A timed rite that drops small burning droplets along a path, scorching anything that crosses them. Its power grows once the caster reaches a higher rank.

rites.name: Serastolia
rites.text: A method of striking that hits a target from across a gap. The attack travels outward from its source, often as a launched missile or a slowly drifting force.

rites.name: Rausium
rites.text: A keeper who reaches mastery may loose a buzzing cloud of many winged stingers. The cloud hunts down inflated floating targets and bursts them for a brief span.

rites.name: Tolistanum
rites.text: A minor, common-tier basic craft that halts a chosen foe in place. If the caster has no coin left, it also calls forth a small golden creature to join the fight.

rites.name: Valantum
rites.text: A dark mist gathers around a sorcerer and lashes out at nearby foes, piercing many at once. The guiding spirit fades into the caster and keeps draining reserves while the power is held.

rites.name: Vianus
rites.text: A sacred rite of a forest-keeping order that lets a guardian of the grove grasp the true shape of the wild. It is practiced only by one chosen warden.

rites.name: Minolium Amostarnus
rites.text: A common minor power that sets a target alight, or inflicts heavy harm on a foe already burning. It carries two uses before it is spent.

rites.name: Ciarenum
rites.text: A sworn discipline taught to guardians who have mastered the basics of holding a line. It removes the rest period after a rapid strike and makes that strike fire every time, as long as a companion has fallen recently.

rites.name: Sillanum Mentisium
rites.text: A chilling force that cannot harm the palest or frozen creatures, yet bites hard into any other foe, especially the heavily armored ones. It is one of the earliest forms of harm known in this realm.

rites.name: Orausanum
rites.text: A chilled enhancement for a frost-casting tower that keeps struck foes sluggish after the ice melts away. Its lingering cold can be deepened further, and it is one of the least costly refinements available.

rites.name: Niselium
rites.text: A minor talent that a wandering trapper can learn, which makes concealing snares hold more value. It needs no earlier training before it can be taken.

rites.name: Orontor
rites.text: A ward-technique that sharpens a caster's piercing spells so they break hardened foes more easily. It can only be learned after the adept has mastered a set of foundational fire-arts and paid a fixed tribute.

rites.name: Valantanum
rites.text: A launching style in which a being's thrown or loosed missiles travel along a bent path rather than a straight line. It is most often the signature craft of looping-throw hunters.

rites.name: Caulium
rites.text: A wizard of the flame arts unleashes a relentless torrent of fire that bursts many foes in quick succession. It works alongside the lesser fire spells the wizard already commands.

rites.name: Serisia
rites.text: A keen watcher's trained gaze that lets a marksman spot hidden foes lurking within concealment. It also lets the marksman choose hidden targets first.

rites.name: Oreniastes
rites.text: A learned enhancement that lets every spellcasting caster break frozen foes, sharpening the strikes of stealthy blades, mighty brawlers, and nature wardens. It can only be gained after a lingering arcane gift is mastered.

rites.name: Serillor
rites.text: A disciplined fighter's training that sharpens reach and quickens strikes. The practitioner gains a pale wrap and a dark cowl once the training is complete.

rites.name: Renasium
rites.text: A grasping rage that swells as a warden strikes more foes in quick succession. Each blow that lands keeps the fury alive, and a pause lets it fade back to nothing.

rites.name: Vistum
rites.text: A venomous swarm technique that hastens the flight of stinging insects and makes their strikes come far more often. It must be learned along with the keeper's hive craft.

rites.name: Moneosia
rites.text: A projectile arcs high over barriers and blockers, striking its mark without needing a clear sightline. Some hurled strikes rise into the sky before crashing down onto their targets.

rites.name: Listor Tantus
rites.text: A rare craft that draws down showers of soft water to help the wielder's allies. It is bought from a trader for a modest sum of coins.

rites.name: Amausium
rites.text: A style of assault where the attacker strikes its foe through direct physical contact. It belongs to a wider family of harm types and is a common way of dealing damage.

rites.name: Goukun
rites.text: Goukun is a concept in Eleirenora, a sealing-force born in the Fall, when the Shards split from the broken worlds. It was the binding current that held the sworn Pact in place while the Sundering tore the old orbits apart.

rites.name: Osumaroma
rites.text: Osumaroma is the concept of a hidden current that ran beneath the Arcane Realm of Eleirenora during the Fall, when the old bonds between worlds gave way to the Sundering. It was the quiet force that let the Shards hold their shape long enough for the Pact to be sworn. Scholars of the Age of Sundering still debate whether it pushed the breaking or merely witnessed it.

rites.name: Leolosia
rites.text: A contest state where neither rival wins nor loses, arising when both sides fall together or endure to a set turn and clear their remaining foes. Its effects differ by arena rules.

rites.name: Rares
rites.text: A tactic where timed strikes split a large sky-beast into fragments, spilling extra coin from the leftover parts. Careful timing decides whether the reward is claimed or lost.

rites.name: Veorauntes
rites.text: A slow eating sickness that clings to a target and gnaws at it every few moments. It keeps working even when nothing else strikes, and a stronger dose overwrites a weaker one.

rites.name: Telarintium
rites.text: A pattern of several missiles launched from one source in a fan shape, each one spaced evenly apart from its neighbors. The launch does not need to circle the full way around.

rites.name: Oriarnia
rites.text: A craft of hurling missiles that snap sharply around their course to strike a marked foe. These darts have no limit on how far they may bend, so they dive hard after targets that try to slip away.

rites.name: Neostiaror
rites.text: A projectile technique that strikes the largest armored juggernauts harder than its usual force. It is a narrower form of a broader practice of wounding giant war-beasts more deeply.

rites.name: Velleosum
rites.text: A bound craft that a caster channels from a sorcerous book, drawing a steady drain of inner energy. It sharpens a summoned spirit's strikes and enlarges the shots it fires until the energy runs dry or the caster lets it go.

rites.name: Nentostum
rites.text: A harm that bursts outward from a blast, but cannot break the darkest shelled spheres or their striped and reinforced kin. It was among the earliest harms ever recorded in its craft.

rites.name: Contum
rites.text: A marksman's technique in which strikes sometimes land with greatly increased force, and the chance of this grows the farther the target stands from the shooter.

rites.name: Taustia
rites.text: A chilling binding that a guardian spirit's strike can call forth, freezing many foes in place briefly without harming them. Its strength grows as the caster advances, and at higher levels it leaves a lingering frost that slows the enemy.

rites.name: Nintia
rites.text: A tentacle surges from a moving pool of water and lashes out five times in quick succession. It strikes any target type but cannot touch anything hidden, and it recharges swiftly after each use.

rites.name: Amirum
rites.text: A stealthy skill used by a swift marksman who strikes from hiding. Their darts slip through enemy ranks and burst the foes that appear without warning.

rites.name: Cauranum
rites.text: A strike style where one attack keeps switching between separate launch points, so a single shot seems to come from two alternating sources. Many fighters gain it through upgrades.

rites.name: Nontia
rites.text: A flight pattern that sends a winged scout along a looping path shaped like a double ring. Early models lock this pattern in place, while later designs use it as their default route.

rites.name: Viares
rites.text: A village-bound craft that halts the slow mending of up to two hundred restoring foes within its reach. Foes that slip beyond its edge stay frozen briefly before they can mend again.

rites.name: Valentium
rites.text: A sticky binding that keeps foes trapped while slowly eating away at their hides. Heavy armored giants are not spared from this slow decay.

rites.name: Tirus
rites.text: A projectile strikes the same foe again and again, the same missile returning to wound a target more than once. Its force fades as it passes through each enemy it touches.

rites.name: Resus
rites.text: A secondary burst that erupts from a projectile already in flight. It cannot appear on its own from nowhere, and it can never itself spawn another burst.

rites.name: Ceosia
rites.text: A slow kindling clings to a foe and gnaws at it every few heartbeats. A fresh flare replaces any weaker smolder, while stronger ones can not be doubled.

rites.name: Amiantanum
rites.text: A frost-bearing upgrade that lets an icy caster sense hidden foes and freeze armored and disguised targets. It carries over the chill of an earlier frost gift, and when combined with a stronger cannon it can focus on concealed enemies first.

rites.name: Maurnanum
rites.text: A common blessing that can be bought for a modest price and grants a quarter more wealth from each fallen foe for two rounds. Its gains add together with other sources of riches.

rites.name: Ceosontum
rites.text: A ritual hex that marks foes with geometric sigils and wears them down over time. Only one caster's mark can take hold, and the strongest working is the one that counts.

rites.name: Cauntarum
rites.text: A dormant force that is poured into a bearer to empower them for a brief stretch. Some tricksters can siphon these borrowed surges away from their rightful holders.

rites.name: Vostium
rites.text: A ward that lets a sentinel strike the shadowed foes that ordinary blasts cannot harm. Blasts of fire and force bounce harmlessly off them, but other attacks break through their dark armor.

rites.name: Tastanum
rites.text: A combat quirk where a strike cannot lock onto a certain violet creature. Most strikes that can reach ordinary foes still hit these, but a specific caster cannot touch them until it grows stronger.

rites.name: Nernor
rites.text: A transformative effect that turns a fleeing foe into a glittering hoard of coin when struck. Anything it touches yields extra wealth upon destruction, and the glow passes to the offspring spawned from it.

rites.name: Cirausum
rites.text: A dulling wash that strips the hidden veil from enemy shapes, leaving them plainly visible to attacks. Some washes reach past every disguise, while others cannot touch certain tough hulks.

rites.name: Solles
rites.text: A shimmering pale aura that spreads over every foe on the field, making them move forty percent faster for a short spell. It recharges between uses and is granted in limited supply at the start of each contest.

rites.name: Valesor
rites.text: A tiered mystical craft that splits a spirit into two, with the copy always fixed on the first target. It can be paired with other workings to multiply their effects.

rites.name: Veostia
rites.text: A costly trickster craft lets its user draw two cards and keep one of them. A chosen creature card becomes cheaper to summon, and only those who wield a certain showman may use it.

rites.name: Corontanium
rites.text: A cold-based force that harms most foes but not the dense, pale, or heavy kinds. It is weaker than the strongest frozen craft and fire-like powers.

rites.name: Coreollia
rites.text: A projectile trait that lets a strike carry extra harm against bodies locked in ice. It is a narrower form of a broader strike-boost that applies to any target.

rites.name: Maustianum
rites.text: A summoner calls forth a colossal crimson hand from the spirit realm that lingers near its caller and smashes nearby foes. Doubling the effect splits it into two alternating hands that strike faster.

rites.name: Listeorium
rites.text: A bonus strike that lands harder against spectral foes than its bearer's normal blow. It belongs to a family of effects that govern how attacks interact with particular kinds of enemies.

rites.name: Mialanum
rites.text: A projectile technique that hits harder against the undead, dealing extra harm to shambling foes with each blow. It belongs to a family of combat effects that alter how strikes land.

rites.name: Orauriastus
rites.text: A knowledge that lets sharp strikes leave a smoldering wound on hurt foes, burning them for a short time afterward. The gift fades if the strike's nature is altered by any other means.

rites.name: Ceolanum
rites.text: A caustic clinging residue that slows its targets and eats away at them steadily. Stronger residues overwrite weaker ones, so the sharpest coating always takes hold.

rites.name: Narnor
rites.text: A final, chilling technique that a cold-craft tower can unleash to halt every creature on the field at once, freezing even the hardiest foes in place. Its power lasts a short while before it must slowly rebuild.

rites.name: Valernanum
rites.text: A tower-keeper's refinement that extends the reach of a caster's watch by a fixed margin. Each strike also lingers noticeably longer than before.

rites.name: Valiasteror
rites.text: A tiered upgrade within a trained-skill tree that lets certain masters hurl more throwing blades and gives one of them extra bombs and smaller blades. It must be unlocked by investing a set number of points and paying a single fee.

rites.name: Coriastanum
rites.text: A tiered skill that widens a fiery ring of heat around its user. It is unlocked by investing a set number of basic training points and requires a sharpened tool to be gained.

rites.name: Maulestor
rites.text: A quality that lets certain strikes shatter bodies sealed in cold. Sharp blows usually fail against them, while blasts and specially tempered force always break the rime.

rites.name: Resostanum
rites.text: A swarm of tiny stingers latches onto a target and gnaws at it steadily over time. The stingers can only pass their harm to one follower and cannot cling to hardened or frozen foes.

rites.name: Teliastor
rites.text: A ring of harm spreads outward from a single point, striking every foe caught within its circle. It differs from strikes that wound only what they directly touch.

rites.name: Relor
rites.text: A projectile habit that hits harder against things that keep growing back after being broken. Each strike deals more than its usual force to those sprouting foes, and it belongs to a wider family of strike effects.

rites.name: Liasaunium
rites.text: A bound capacity that lets certain defenders strike at spectral foes that ordinary blows pass through. Such harm usually demands a charge drawn from elemental forces.

rites.name: Coraulles
rites.text: A rare tonic that grants its user a single steadfast undead sentinel. The guardian strikes swiftly and coats foes in a sticky, slowing ichor, and it stands watch for four cycles before fading.

rites.name: Teleonialor
rites.text: A bolt of force that strikes harder against guarded foes than it does against bare ones. Its power splits and breaks the protective barriers that surround enemies, dealing extra harm to shielded targets.

rites.name: Coleontia
rites.text: A minor support lore that strengthens every snare trap and its largest variants, adding a small bonus to their capacity. It must be studied across several prior lessons before it can be learned.

rites.name: Meoniarnium
rites.text: A tagged condition that brands a foe so that it suffers doubled harm from certain hunters and yields twice the reward when struck down. Bearers display a glowing sign, and a hunter may later unleash a strike against all branded foes at once.

rites.name: Lesiranum
rites.text: A guiding discipline that lifts nearby lesser handlers with free basic training, wider reach, and quicker recovery of their skills. Their shots pierce further and fly faster under its influence.

rites.name: Launisia
rites.text: A strike style that can slip through guarded foes while it still has reach left to spend. It shows up across several tiered armaments, and the tie-breaking code treats it as its own rule.

rites.name: Lesteontes
rites.text: A withering affliction that saps the life from a foe, slowing its movement and leaving it more vulnerable to harm from every source.

rites.name: Siarnallia
rites.text: A harvesting craft in which a creature that cannot be broken by force is repeatedly pushed back by a gust, so that earners can keep gathering wealth while the cycle never ends.

rites.name: Liasor
rites.text: A lingering effect that drags foes into a lower pace, never freezing them entirely yet never letting them run at full speed. It clings to creatures in a sticky, lasting way.

rites.name: Meolliarium
rites.text: A relentless homing force that locks onto a single chosen foe and chases it without pause. It ignores every other foe in its path until the target is destroyed or escapes beyond the edge of the field.

rites.name: Oraullus
rites.text: A learned discipline that quickens the growth of every companion in a band each cycle, though it adds little to those who have already mastered their full arts. It must be taken up after three lesser teachings are gathered.

rites.name: Cianor Ceres
rites.text: A volley style where a burst of projectiles fans outward with uneven gaps between them. The randomness is slight and somewhat controllable, and any spread missing even spacing counts.

rites.name: Tarnesium
rites.text: A shimmering gust-barrier that shoves nearby enemies backward on contact. It can strike a limited number of foes at once and lasts for a short time before it must rest.

rites.name: Veror
rites.text: A form of harm that arrives once for each passing cycle of a contest. Many of these effects grant lump sums of wealth or produce a fixed count of projectiles at every turn.

rites.name: Celum
rites.text: A damage type that strikes hard against single foes but scatters poorly across crowds. Its bursts fall within short reach and it cannot harm the hardest shells.

rites.name: Lilarnus
rites.text: A common-tier pulse of crimson balloon spirits that, once awakened, rise in alternation from each side's queue, first the caller's ranks and then the rival's.

rites.name: Tiarum
rites.text: A later refinement of a frost-bearing engine lets its bearer re-chill any stilled foe, whatever force first held it, shifting its chill into a deeper, glacial strain.

rites.name: Amaranum Noraullus
rites.text: A learned craft that lengthens the freezing hold of two frost techniques by one heartbeat. It must be studied at length and bought once before its benefit can be drawn upon.

rites.name: Tornestanum
rites.text: A caster's fallen foes rise as hollow spirits that march toward the gate, striking any foe they meet. Their power grows as the caster gathers more remains in a private reserve.

rites.name: Solenanum
rites.text: A tactical knowledge point that lengthens a steadfast surge of aid from a fifteen-second span to twenty seconds. It can only be claimed once a companion ward of prolonged halting has been unlocked.

rites.name: Renus Tianeontus
rites.text: A sudden erasure that unmakes a target outright, wiping away every hidden layer within it no matter how sturdy it was. Only a few craftsmen know how to wield it, and fewer still can unmake the greatest floating giants.

rites.name: Lesaurnanum
rites.text: A targeting rule where strikes pick their victims by pure chance rather than any order. It governs the attacks of a few named wielders and a hidden agent.

rites.name: Telauntia
rites.text: A chilled condition that sprouts sharp ice shards onto a frozen foe. Renewing the freeze replaces the old spikes with new ones once the chill fades, and the shards linger until they wear away or strike something.

rites.name: Telianeosor
rites.text: A learned enhancement within a primary knowledge branch that extends the duration of charge-based powers. It requires a prerequisite investment and a one-time payment to unlock.

rites.name: Sollus
rites.text: A defensive craft in which a guardian answers each breach of its line with a set counter-action. The response triggers on every breach, no matter how many defenders remain standing.

rites.name: Mirnauntia
rites.text: A swift restoration craft that refills the readied charges of a chosen ally on your side. It is a costly technique, paid in a rare metal.

rites.name: Oriantor
rites.text: A craft in which a creature is held fixed in place and made immune to outside harm. Only a few devices or users manage to bind their prey this way.

rites.name: Raunor
rites.text: A bright and wicked surge that every stationed defender briefly gains, letting its strikes pierce even the darkest and toughest foes. It can only be stored and wielded within a single contested border zone.

rites.name: Lialanum Larostanum
rites.text: A crackling strike hurled from a wand-wielding apprentice that bursts through many weak foes at once. It reaches beyond the caster's reach, but it can only sear away one layer from each target.

rites.name: Rastus Valiasaulor
rites.text: A frost art that turns chilled foes brittle so they burst into sharp fragments. The fragments scatter and wound nearby enemies.

rites.name: Rarnia
rites.text: A sticky binding fluid that slows down fragile floating targets. Stronger versions of the fluid overwrite weaker ones, and a target already caught in it cannot be caught again until the fluid wears away.

rites.name: Riastinum
rites.text: A fifth and final refinement of a village's rallying craft, it doubles the speed and piercing strength of every guardian in sight for twenty moments. The surge can be called again once its recovery period has passed.

rites.name: Oreosus
rites.text: A quick-casting charm that a spirit-caller can draw from a ledger of arts. It lets a bound spirit move and turn much faster for a short stretch, at a cost of stored energy.

rites.name: Coneosor
rites.text: A projectile technique in which a strike leaps in a straight line from one foe to the next after landing a blow. It is distinct from attacks that curve toward targets on their own.

rites.name: Amaneosus
rites.text: A strike that turns a foe into a crimson husk, a weaker form that still threatens to fall. Certain charms and rituals can bring this change about on lesser enemies.

rites.name: Leorantes
rites.text: A standing law that makes wounded layers knit back twice as quickly. It is always bound to a companion rule that halts the mending.

rites.name: Liares
rites.text: A minor binding craft that halts a chosen guardian for a single turn. It is one of the simplest powers a wielder can learn.

rites.name: Selanum
rites.text: A common-cost surge that a holder spends to empower every guardian under their command against the hardest armored foes. It grows the strength of all defenders when facing heavy shells and massive hulks.

rites.name: Oreliarnus
rites.text: A protective ward wraps around a commander's reserve of lives, soaking up many blows before it fades. It slowly mends itself by a few points each round when no losses have occurred.

rites.name: Amornus Rantaures
rites.text: A rallying signal that a village keeper sounds to briefly double the speed and striking force of every guardian within its reach. It can be called again only after a long pause.

rites.name: Mostantium
rites.text: A minor craft that occasionally hurls an incoming foe backward for a fleeting moment. It is sharpened further when wielded by those who guard and aid their allies.

rites.name: Rilleornus
rites.text: A costly rite that dissolves one standing bastion, and the caster bears a wound scaled to the bastion's worth. It can only be invoked by a warden of the final ruinous rank.

rites.name: Ceria
rites.text: A binding craft that nails down the weakest foes for a single moment, freezing them in place. Hardened and armored enemies resist it entirely, and it can spread to allied constructs when they are properly fitted.

rites.name: Siallornum
rites.text: A chosen art that a single wielder may draw upon to unleash flame, and when a foe already burns, a far fiercer blast. It opens with the first foe struck and then lets the user select three further gifts.

rites.name: Serilus Nelia
rites.text: A constant enhancement that lets every strike set a foe alight, so that the marked targets keep smoldering and losing strength over time. It is earned only after a long proving trial.

rites.name: Seraurnus
rites.text: A costly advanced charm that quickens one chosen ally, shortening its wait by a single beat until nothing remains to wait for.

rites.name: Reniantus
rites.text: A bound spirit can be forced to burst outward at once, scattering piercing harm around it. It returns to form after a brief pause and can be doubled through a linked echo.

rites.name: Rolauranum
rites.text: A firing pattern that releases a ring of evenly spaced missiles in every direction at once. Many launching devices gain it through upgrades, though a few common ones lack it.

rites.name: Vaullanum
rites.text: A strike that answers only what crosses into view from beyond the edge. Anything already present when it lands, and whatever spawns from it, passes untouched, the reverse of most assaults.

rites.name: Oreostonia
rites.text: A blazing circular ward that encircles its bearer in a solid wall of fire. It burns anything that drifts close enough to touch it, though it cannot sense hidden foes without a watchful companion nearby.

rites.name: Rosor
rites.text: A learned refinement of a cold-touched caster's craft that extends the reach of its frost-bearing hands. It must be studied with a modest store of invested insight and a supply of dry rations.

rites.name: Seraunanum
rites.text: A harm that is laid directly upon the roadway and remains there for a set span, striking whatever passes over it. It only touches one stretch of the path, and the makers must stand close enough to the roadway to bring it about.

rites.name: Saurnintum
rites.text: A first-tier enhancement for a lesser apprentice-caster that lets its orbs strike a wider reach of foes, including those locked in ice. The orbs also shimmer in three bright hues.

rites.name: Corianor
rites.text: A projectile glides along a rolling, undulating course, tracing repeated curves like a rising and falling tide. Its wave can tighten into faster cycles when pushed harder.

rites.name: Raustes
rites.text: A rare charge that quickens every guardian's strikes for a short span of cycles. Its power lingers longer as the bearer grows in rank, and it must rest for a while before it can be called again.

rites.name: Veonaurus
rites.text: A aiming rule that makes a launcher hurl its shots as close as possible to the far exit of each path. Only one particular trap can use this rule today.

rites.name: Ceolles
rites.text: A tower's ability to harm heavily armored foes that shield their kind. Explosive blasts and certain damage types can break through, and many defenders gain this skill after an upgrade.

rites.name: Ciallor
rites.text: A reserve method that keeps a participant from ending when their vitality runs out, restoring a set measure of it. It counts among a larger family of harmful effects and can be called on only a few times per contest.

rites.name: Oreorium
rites.text: A lasting extension to a freezing power that holds its effect for a longer span. It can only be learned after a prior tier of training has been awakened.

rites.name: Telines
rites.text: A strike method in which a force instantly locates its target and lands upon it without travel. It is the swiftest form of pursuit, unlike slower pursuits that send a missile along the way.

rites.name: Sernastanum
rites.text: A chilling enhancement that holds struck foes motionless a little while longer. It is later folded into fuller frost techniques that bind foes even more firmly.

rites.name: Alaerora
rites.text: Alaerora is the concept of walls held against the dark, as understood in the Walled Age of Eleirenora, when orders and churches raised barriers that outlasted their builders. It is less a force than a principle: that what is enclosed can be kept safe, and what is kept can be thinned or broken by time.

rites.name: Amentor
rites.text: Amentor is the concept of a binding pact sworn between wardens and the flame-temples of Eleirenora during the Walled Age, when its order held the first crossings against the drowned roads. Its practitioners could seal a breach in stone and fire together, a working remembered as the vow that outlasted three sieges.

rites.name: Tostum
rites.text: A tactic of pouring every available enhancement into one mighty guardian until it dominates the field. It is most common in one particular sort of tower-defense contest and can be used across nearly any of its editions.

rites.name: Serantus
rites.text: A temporary weakening that makes a target take extra harm from every direct attack for a short span. Several such weakenings can pile up, though two of the same kind do not.

rites.name: Raullus
rites.text: A launched strike that hits the great lords of a horde harder than ordinary foes. Its heavier blow is doubled against the mightiest champions, though only certain war engines carry it.

rites.name: Serum
rites.text: A tower's fourth-tier ability drenches the whole battlefield in sticky goo, binding every foe including the largest ones. The sticking enemies take extra harm and lose their resistance to freezing and lead.

rites.name: Vallium
rites.text: A combat craft in which a defender grows quicker in striking as more separate foes press close enough to enter its reach. It differs from a rage that swells with the total strength of every foe on the field.

rites.name: Ameoseror
rites.text: A tuning module that lets a hunting vessel strike any foe lying inside the reach of a neighboring guardian. The vessel's watch then spans far beyond its own range.

rites.name: Maurnes
rites.text: A second-tier enhancement for a Path 2 unit that siphons two lives from a rival every fifteen seconds in offense or grants two lives to its owner in defense. It cannot drop a foe below one life and pays a bounty instead, costing six hundred coins.

rites.name: Ciastesor
rites.text: A fourth-tier enhancement for a sky-bound sentinel that doubles its strike force and sharpens its ice shards. Frozen foes take triple harm, and shattered frost leaves shards that slow nearby enemies before bursting.

rites.name: Coranus
rites.text: A tower alters its strikes according to how far the enemies have journeyed along the route. Enemies nearer the exit provoke a sharper response from the defender.

rites.name: Rones
rites.text: A mechanic in which a charged ability is instantly made ready to use again. Only champions can perform it, and it is granted by a special upgrade.

rites.name: Mostialum
rites.text: A strike that peels away the outermost shell of a target no matter how sturdy it is. Its effect is distinct from flat extra harm, and it leaves any offspring of the shell unaffected.

rites.name: Tenisus
rites.text: A tuned upgrade for a fire-breathing tool that makes its burning bolts travel half again as swiftly. It is part of an early tier of a fixed skill web of arcane knowledge.

rites.name: Seristor
rites.text: A tactical refinement that lets fire-hurling engines scorch their targets more often. It shortens the pause between each burning pulse, so flames inflict harm at a quicker pace.

rites.name: Reollia
rites.text: A tactical technique that lets marksmen briefly dull the momentum of armored foes. It is unlocked only after a specialized warrior course and needs no other preparation.

rites.name: Taulia
rites.text: A tower's fifth upgrade turns each follow-up blast into one larger explosion that strikes for a fixed amount and can break tough shielded foes. Its passive storm can wipe out leaked enemies before any life is lost.

rites.name: Serornillus
rites.text: A condition that spreads through a balloon-like creature as visible gashes and steady puffs of escaping air. The creature slowly loses its strength over time, and each new strike renews the drain.

rites.name: Telernus
rites.text: A tuned rite that alters every fifth wandering creature, granting it a hidden shroud, a swift rebirth, or a leap to a sturdier form. Stacked rites can compound these changes, making early waves far more dangerous.

rites.name: Vonalus
rites.text: A frost-based harm that can wound most creatures except the violet and pale ones. It falls short of the strongest ice and fire harms because it cannot break through those two kinds.

rites.name: Ceorirnia
rites.text: A learned craft that lets a practitioner pass concealed shades onto another person's kin. It is taught within a research hall where such methods are studied and refined.

rites.name: Meliares
rites.text: A final-tier craft that a sky-warden can invoke to unleash a sudden blast that strikes every foe in sight at once. It is the capstone of one training path.

rites.name: Ceostines
rites.text: A lone guardian craft that lets the first thorn-foundry raised in a field be built for a cheaper sum of coin. It can only be learned after a prior lesson in sharpening thorns is mastered.

rites.name: Voliarnes
rites.text: A chosen aim that marks the foremost threats for the watchers who shoot from afar. It favors foes that split into many pieces, and when a foe nears the far gate, it reaches for the one that is closest to escape.

rites.name: Telernia
rites.text: A flight-aiming setting for a sky-striker that keeps its shots steady along a central line. Its reach is shorter in the smaller battlegrounds, so it matches the scale of each arena.

rites.name: Teornium Viror
rites.text: A crackling force that strikes nearly every kind of foe, failing only against the hardest shells. Arcane casters draw on it by default, and some siege engines switch to it to bypass armor.

rites.name: Laustia
rites.text: Two or more crossing energy beams briefly form glowing pools that burn the targets they touch. The pools can pierce hidden foes and drain them over a few seconds.

rites.name: Millontum
rites.text: A quality that lets certain attacks break fragile glass shells, while energy-based strikes pass harmlessly through them. Its strength grows with each shell's layers.

rites.name: Nolistus
rites.text: A craft that lets the crackling bolts spilling from a sky-sphere also seize foes in frost. It needs a set amount of learned lore and an earlier discovery before it can be taken up.

rites.name: Orellus
rites.text: A mounting fury that grows stronger with each blow struck, quickening a keeper's strikes until a lull in the fighting calms it. Its surge doubles when joined with a second kindling of vengeance.

rites.name: Seornianus
rites.text: A property where a machine or spirit cannot detect or strike hardened clay foes, only softer ones. Some strikers gain the power to reach these shelled foes only after growing stronger.

rites.name: Amolor
rites.text: A chilling wind that slows nearby frozen-vulnerable creatures and lets land-bound constructions be raised atop nearby waters. Where it blows, the water hardens into a crossable surface, but the hardened ground fails if the wind is stilled.

rites.name: Salia
rites.text: A slow-drifting orb of crackling sky-fire that freezes anything it brushes and calls down bolts of lightning on nearby foes. It cannot pass through the toughest shells and fades away when it does.

rites.name: Oraurnelum
rites.text: A tiered technique in a martial tradition that lets a barrage of hurled charges briefly freeze targets in place. It must be learned through sustained study and requires a sudden, forced awakening to unlock.

rites.name: Meostontia
rites.text: A powerful energy fist that a fighter summons in front of itself to strike many foes rapidly. Its reach is short, and it can crush large armored targets with heavy blows.

rites.name: Misarum
rites.text: A tactical setting that a bearer unlocks upon reaching a set rank, letting them command a second companion construct. It directs the first and fourth constructs toward the nearest foe, while the second and third strike the most powerful target.

rites.name: Mallanum
rites.text: A tiered discipline that grants every soldier-ape an immediate burst of experience upon entering a contest. It also quickens their steady gain of experience while the discipline stays in force.

rites.name: Raustinanum
rites.text: A force that hurls the marked creatures away from their goal, sending them to another point along the route or off it entirely. They can still be struck while they are flung.

rites.name: Niastus
rites.text: A strike strips away the protective reinforcement from a shielded foe, halving the outer layer's durability and leaving it exposed. Larger armored foes lose their reinforcement along with their descendants.

rites.name: Seraullus
rites.text: A stronger corrosive residue that a sticky tool applies, dissolving small foes at a quickened pace. It is the third refinement along its line of advancement.

rites.name: Amaullanum
rites.text: A paid tactical strike that a commander can call in during a battle against a massive chief foe. It delivers a heavy blow of fixed force to that foe and drains a set amount of the commander's resources to activate.

rites.name: Senia
rites.text: A volatile mixture clings to certain foes, and when one of them bursts it detonates, damaging nearby enemies except its own offspring. The mixture takes hold only after the outer shell is pierced.

rites.name: Tantaunia
rites.text: A property of certain strikes that deal extra harm to armored foes on every blow. It belongs to a wider family of enhanced damage and is found on a few blunt, non-corrosive attacks.

rites.name: Tallor
rites.text: A craft that lets a certain tinker's strikes transform foes into shining gold. The gain costs some of the strike's piercing power, and the scale depends on how rare the craft is.

rites.name: Ternania
rites.text: A rare, costly craft that a bargainer can channel to seize a rival's servant and bind it to their own side. If no room remains for the captive, it is dissolved entirely.

rites.name: Morum
rites.text: A lingering effect that turns a plain metal target into steady coin whenever a strike lands on it. Destroying the transformed target instantly pays out a sum that changes with the rules in play.

rites.name: Valialaunor
rites.text: A final refinement of a sky-watcher's technique that splits volleys into more arrows and strikes harder at long range. It grows stronger the more foes are bunched together.

rites.name: Tiantaurnum
rites.text: A hostile method that strips remaining lives directly, bypassing the usual leaks. Certain shields cannot block it, and it cannot finish off the holder of the final life.

rites.name: Tiantalus
rites.text: A charged strike bites deeper into any foe already struck by a stunning arc of energy. Each blow lands harder than the striker's usual force against such a target.

rites.name: Narneostium
rites.text: A projectile wanders along unpredictable, serpentine paths that the wielder cannot steer. Careful placement or sharpened aim can tame some of this randomness.

rites.name: Roria
rites.text: A final-tier upgrade that grants a charged special ability, which must be readied before a battle and triggered by a click. Once used, it lies dormant until it slowly refills.

rites.name: Teleoralum
rites.text: A coined craft of channeled force that a caster can unleash from a limb after reaching the final tier of its branch. It cannot break hardened foes unless a special study is undertaken first.

rites.name: Corirum
rites.text: A set of triggered powers that defenders can call upon at will, each recharging over time. Stronger tiers of the craft refine earlier powers, and certain mentors and relics shorten the wait between uses.

rites.name: Rarianes
rites.text: A minor discipline of the monkey orders that lowers the price of a portable pool of water to forty coins. It requires no earlier training before it can be learned.

rites.name: Veollauror
rites.text: A tribe's sealed ritual that weakens the great heavy beasts marching from the gate, sparing their chieftains. When two such rites are woven together, the weakening deepens far beyond the sum of its parts.

rites.name: Mauliarus
rites.text: A lingering affliction that gnaws at a target across a span of moments, dealing harm in repeated pulses. Fresh applications renew the torment, and some afflictions can pile atop one another while others cannot.

rites.name: Telaurnor
rites.text: A tactic in which an attack deals extra harm to targets already burdened by a lingering affliction, such as slowing or damage over time. It is a narrower form of a broader extra-damage rule.

rites.name: Valelus
rites.text: A harsh technique in which each blow delivers more than its ordinary harm to a particular kind of foe. Its surplus force can be seen as a heavy plummet dropped on a target.

rites.name: Valonus
rites.text: A fourth-tier command rite that a settlement of watchers can call upon. When invoked, every defender present quickens its strikes and pierces more deeply for a short span, and the rite must rest before it can be called again.

rites.name: Telarnus
rites.text: A keen-edged art of the reckoning-halls that lets every striker in a host pierce deeper through its foe. Its ancient form once gave each hurled bolt a longer flight, before that trait passed to a different discipline.

rites.name: Miasornanum
rites.text: A practiced method for gathering progress points at a rapid pace so a traveler climbs the ranks sooner. Ordinarily these points come from long hours of play or from defeating many enemies.

rites.name: Tostium
rites.text: A tuned trigger-craft that lets the long-reaching marksman fire more often. Its shots come out at a steadier pace, quickening the marksman's rate of attack.

rites.name: Carium
rites.text: A tactical doctrine taught in the martial branch of a learning tree. It quickens the strikes of ranged marksmen, underwater raiders, and sea-going privateers when they are ordered to press the most-wounded foe.

rites.name: Ceoliaria
rites.text: A hero-bound craft that lets every strike from a champion deal one extra harm to the largest armored foes. It also reaches the lesser helpers that a champion calls forth, and it must be earned through deep training and a single paid tribute.

rites.name: Coresauntum
rites.text: A ranged attendant can call a pulse that drags every foe on the field into a slow crawl for a short spell. The pulse cannot touch the largest and most fearsome foes, and it renews only after a long pause.

rites.name: Sianastium
rites.text: A constant enhancement that lets thrown projectiles rebound off the edges of the field. It is a lasting two-tier boon bestowed upon the marksmen who carry it.

rites.name: Valasauntus
rites.text: A devastating strike that lands with crushing force on a target, unleashing damage far beyond an ordinary blow. Certain marksmen, machines, and charms can unleash it once properly enhanced.

rites.name: Valoniantus
rites.text: A tuned enhancement that adds extra harm against the largest hostile foes, and adds even more when the strike comes from a champion fighter.

rites.name: Riallor
rites.text: A timed deluge of clinging gum washes over every foe in view, repeatedly re-coating them for several seconds. Lead-shelled targets lose their armor while stuck, and even hidden enemies are caught.

rites.name: Tantialor
rites.text: A reward power that unleashes a rapid barrage of explosive shells and heavy crushing blasts against the largest foes. It is weak against certain armored targets unless specially prepared.

rites.name: Teliastes
rites.text: A targeting method that aims as far back toward the origin of a path as it can reach, following any passing foe until none remain nearby, then turning back. It may aim along several converging routes at once.

rites.name: Rallor
rites.text: A costly rite that conjures a short-lived twin of a chosen champion, placed anywhere they could stand. The twin carries over every trinket and enhancement the original bears.

rites.name: Silleones
rites.text: A tuning that quickens the flight of every aerial dart launched by the sky-striking gunners. It can only be taken up after the wing-craft training has been mastered.

rites.name: Veollum
rites.text: A defensive craft lets a turret burst apart many drifting targets at once. It works through spreading shots, swift piercing strikes, or blasts that engulf whole clusters, making it valuable when waves arrive in huge numbers.

rites.name: Tollus
rites.text: A fragile condition that lets a frozen target be harmed by blows that would normally fail against it. It cannot pile up, though reapplying it renews its duration.

rites.name: Caulostus
rites.text: A fighting style where strikes can land on any spot in view, regardless of where the fighter stands. Lines of sight are ignored, so distance and cover do not matter for the strike.

rites.name: Reosia
rites.text: A tactic where a skilled striker unveils hidden foes by stripping away their concealment. It works on any strike, and even tears the veils from marked targets that resist ordinary attacks.

rites.name: Salor
rites.text: A spellcaster's bolts curve toward their targets and can strike past obstacles that normally block sight. The effect lasts longer, letting the magic chase down enemies over a wider reach.

rites.name: Mornor
rites.text: Special traits that reshape the form of a creature, granting it added resistances or greater durability. Some types of harm interact with these traits in different ways, and certain traits can split into copies when struck.

rites.name: Senollanum
rites.text: A chilling force that stops a foe's movement by locking it in cold. Lesser foes caught by it are frozen solid, while the toughest shells shrug it off.

rites.name: Mernum
rites.text: A constant three-star enhancement that makes every launched projectile burst apart when its travel ends. It works much like an older bursting-missile boon that causes all shots to detonate on expiry.

rites.name: Valaunentes
rites.text: A power that lets certain defenders perceive and strike foes hidden from ordinary sight. Some allies grant this sight to nearby defenders, and many defenders gain it through special training or gear.

rites.name: Sonia
rites.text: A coined beam-craft that periodically lets a user fire focused lances able to shatter brittle glass-shelled foes. How often it works grows with how far the practitioner has advanced in study.

rites.name: Molor
rites.text: A temporary binding that halts a creature's ability to mend its lost parts. Once the binding fades, the creature can slowly rebuild what was taken from it again.

rites.name: Amirarnia
rites.text: A rare, once-per-journey charm that, when every life is spent, restores all lives, replays the current stage, and grants a sizable cache of gold.

rites.name: Valernus
rites.text: A tactical enhancement that lets spike-launching turrets shatter frozen foes. It is gained by first mastering a quicker barrage skill, and a whetstone can still sharpen the spikes further.

rites.name: Amirium
rites.text: A support discipline that quickens the strikes of a supreme champion whenever no rival of its kind stands on the field. Its quickening compounds with a separate training art, leaving the champion slightly faster than either alone would make it.

rites.name: Orasaullia
rites.text: A searing energy that bursts through most foes, sparing only the mirrored and violet. It is a close cousin of ordinary force, distinguished chiefly by its hungry, ionized glare.

rites.name: Serauntes Tauntor
rites.text: A minor sustained gift that adds one more barb to each hazard of a certain kind, bringing the total to a fixed count. It requires nothing before it can be learned.

rites.name: Masaurnia
rites.text: This is a fourth-tier rite of the Wildtender path that grants nearby tenders a stacking rush of quickened strikes and piercing force. It compounds with other rites for an even greater surge.

rites.name: Liarium
rites.text: A hidden rite that lets every member of a band strike at any spot across the whole isle. Its lore is said to have been stored away long ago within old runes.

rites.name: Tallornia
rites.text: A siege engine unleashes a rolling storm of stunning concussions that freeze foes in place. Each pulse scorches everything on the field for a short, brutal span.

rites.name: Nillium
rites.text: A sticky ooze technique where each popped target sends a jolt through nearby foes, briefly freezing them. Heavy foes cling to the goo longer and suffer extra corrosion.

rites.name: Tiarnum
rites.text: A charm that quickens every spellcaster of the arcane arts. The gift strengthens their rhythm, though all other crafts grow dearer to sustain it.

rites.name: Valeorium
rites.text: A targeting option that reverses the flight course of a skyborne striker, so it returns over ground it already crossed. A short recharge stops it from being reused at once, though the recharge refills between rounds.

rites.name: Cilanum Teleorestor
rites.text: A standing enchantment that is always available from the start. It conjures a twin of the caster that copies every step sideways and upward, letting the bearer watch and reach across a wider span.

rites.name: Amirestes
rites.text: A single-hit striking method where each projectile breaks through only one target and ignores any added penetration boosts. Certain fixed-count variants can pierce a small set number of foes instead.

rites.name: Marnes
rites.text: A costly sigil that, once invoked, summons a shimmering rose-colored mist that drifts in looping patterns and fires piercing beams at foes. It cannot see anything cloaked in shadow, and its presence fades after a few cycles.

rites.name: Cilaunum
rites.text: A harmless kind of force that never strikes a foe directly. It instead lends help to nearby allies, boosting their strength and their stores of wealth.

rites.name: Miarnastor
rites.text: A passive discipline that lets every champion in a company strike and act more rapidly. It must be learned after three lessons of champion training and a prior swiftness rite, and it costs no separate purchase of coin.

rites.name: Siasanum
rites.text: A placeable beacon that calls down a lesser tempest of force upon the foe, striking everything in its reach. It recharges slowly and must be earned through repeated use of the greater storm it echoes.

rites.name: Seriantus
rites.text: A passive charm that unlocks after a long trial and hides all hostile drifters from sight. Their hidden bodies scatter many more small tokens when they burst.

rites.name: Viallum
rites.text: A rare, costly power that sacrifices your own handler to unleash harm across everything in view. The blast ignores any stored charges and strikes all targets alike.

rites.name: Seraullia
rites.text: A learned enhancement that lets most arcane missiles hang in the air longer before fading. Three specific arcane forms are excluded, and the lesson needs no prior study.

rites.name: Valanum
rites.text: A clinging charge that bonds to a floating carrier and bursts with heavy force, hitting every nearby foe except the ones born from it. It reaches farther than its lesser version and can be layered with it.

rites.name: Mirantium
rites.text: A common kind of force that can strike every target marked for harm in a contest, though it cannot touch hidden foes. Some defenders gain it briefly when they stand within the reach of a watchful office.

rites.name: Corintesium
rites.text: A learned refinement that lets a sticky spatter cling to more foes at once. It also boosts the piercing reach of corrosive pools left behind by certain devices.

rites.name: Corantianum
rites.text: A style of assault where a single source releases several identical strikes, each choosing its own target. Some versions link the strikes together so that one shot's aim decides where the others fly.

rites.name: Rorum
rites.text: A bound charm of protective energy that raises a barrier able to soak up a large number of losses. The barrier slowly mends itself after each calm round and can be layered with a lesser ward of the same kind.

rites.name: Valires Soristia
rites.text: A temporary charm that turns a sturdy guardian into a stealthy striker. It periodically releases a slow but forceful crossed wave, and two companion strikers hurl rapid star-blades that falter against armored foes unless further study is done.

rites.name: Ameria
rites.text: A combat method in which a weapon alternates between two strike forms, changing its effect on every shot or on each target struck. It belongs to a family of striking techniques and works best when paired with other tactics.

rites.name: Rorium
rites.text: A tiered enhancement that strengthens a storm-calling ability, adding a large sum of extra harm to each strike. It can only be unlocked after several prerequisite upgrades and a set number of investment points are spent.

rites.name: Monium
rites.text: A shop-bought effect that wraps a fiery glow around the moment a defender is set down or strengthened. It belongs to one specific hero and is unlocked by spending currency at a trophy vendor.

rites.name: Valesaulus
rites.text: A supportive strike that never harms its target, no matter what aid or amplification it receives. Many helper actions carry this trait, though some strikes still wound certain foes in specific ways.

rites.name: Tiastanum
rites.text: A final-tier surge that calls forth a supercharged bolt wave, which stretches as the caster moves along its path. The surge lasts for a set span and comes at a steep price.

rites.name: Serolor Rolliania
rites.text: A tuned trait that lets a thrown bolt gain extra piercing force and bounce onward to any foe in view. The bolt keeps seeking the most advanced enemy after each rebound.

rites.name: Cerintia
rites.text: A cold force that shatters armored foes but fails against pale unarmored ones. It is the standard chill used by frost wardens, and it can break even frozen shells.

rites.name: Voneontum
rites.text: A paid rite that lets a champion leap straight to the tenth rank of mastery, skipping the slow climb. Its price rises with each rank already earned, and it is barred from rival trials and the boss gauntlet.

rites.name: Vesiares
rites.text: A style of strike that fires a straight rectangular band of searing energy, hitting everything inside it at once. It needs no physical missile and passes harmlessly over certain shielding.

rites.name: Lanum
rites.text: A tinkerer's final refinement lets a mechanic's ember-hot spanner double the quickening of a chosen machine for a short burst. Once spent, it recharges and can be called upon again at once.

rites.name: Amiarnum
rites.text: A mechanic where elevated defenders can look past every barrier that would normally block their view. It does not extend how far they can strike, and it appears mainly on boards built around it.

rites.name: Cestornia
rites.text: A sticky chemical bond that slows targets and eats away at them steadily. A stronger version of the bond replaces weaker ones and resists being reapplied until it wears off.

rites.name: Mernontes
rites.text: A restorative art granted by a rare relic, active only within disputed lands. When no harm is taken during a cycle, the bearer recovers twenty measures of vitality as each cycle closes.

rites.name: Nontastes
rites.text: A constant minor enhancement that a user unlocks after finishing a late stage. It makes the sudden great powers recharge faster and be used more often, with the bonus growing at higher levels.

rites.name: Serisiarnia
rites.text: A sea-creature's final ascension that calls forth a freezing flood across the battlefield. It chills nearly every foe, slowing them for a time, while summoning frost orbs that bounce off the edges of the field.

rites.name: Millaurnes
rites.text: A basic incantation that drains a caster's stored essence and converts it into coin at a fixed rate. Its coin-making effect is blocked in certain sealed trials, where it cannot be used at all.

rites.name: Tiasenus
rites.text: A lingering glowing hazard that wears away at anything caught inside its drifting field. Harm continues only while a target remains within reach of its source, and nearby sources never add their harm together.

rites.name: Amerianes
rites.text: A fixed aiming mode that turns a gun-tower toward a chosen spot and holds it there. The target can be moved anywhere in view, and the aim defaults to the screen's middle if none was set.

rites.name: Orantor
rites.text: A small ring of charged energy that briefly circles its wearer and damages every foe caught within its reach. It cannot harm the hardest armored foes.

rites.name: Sereollia Ventium
rites.text: A stronger form of a shoving power that pushes foes backward more forcefully and slows the heaviest and toughest among them. It can be unlocked only after a far-reaching gift is mastered, and it strengthens related guardians too.

rites.name: Orauriasus
rites.text: A hypnotic tune that lures the largest armored foes into a slow drift against the flow of their path. Its song can be anchored to a chosen spot within reach and recalled at will.

rites.name: Listausium
rites.text: A dark dye is smeared over swift floating foes, dragging their pace down. The heaviest giants resist it, slowing only a little.

rites.name: Ventum
rites.text: A tower's frozen foes sprout jagged crystal spikes that wound nearby targets. The growth shatters faster when the attacks come quicker.

rites.name: Nauses
rites.text: A tuned perception that lets a sorcerer's apprentice strike hidden targets, though it grants no sight to others. It is a lesser sibling of a seeing orb and leaves the caster's reach unchanged.

rites.name: Coreles
rites.text: A coiled status in which tiny spikes are driven into a target to hold it motionless. Anything struck by these spikes can be broken regardless of the force used against it.

rites.name: Corosentum
rites.text: A sharpened technique in a training lineage of striking discipline. It boosts the force of special sweeping recoils, driving foes backward thirty percent farther, and must be earned after eight levels of basic study and a bounce-mastery prerequisite.

rites.name: Lereonia
rites.text: A shared bond formed when a group of companions each call upon their gathered energies together. Completing this bond rewards every participant with a pouch of trade coin.

rites.name: Tirneoria
rites.text: A tuning upgrade for hurled throwing discs that lets each one loop around a second time before coming back, provided it has not yet struck its full quota of targets. It requires prior investment in the bounce craft.

rites.name: Vanum
rites.text: A charged gift that rains bursts of barbed orbs across the central ground, shattering nearly every foe except those sheathed in heavy metal. It can be claimed from a finished hall once every fifteen hours.

rites.name: Resonanum
rites.text: A sticky binding that holds a creature in place, leaving it dazed and unable to move. Certain striking forces ignore the binding and still cannot harm the trapped target more.

rites.name: Mauntus
rites.text: A tearing affliction that rips apart a foe's outer shell, causing it to bleed away its strength over several moments. Only a particular spinning blade can inflict it, and the first struck foe suffers the most.

rites.name: Telenteonor
rites.text: A charm that makes every spell-caster's bolts pierce through foes and last longer. Their projectiles then circle the caster in a turning ring.

rites.name: Valaurnus
rites.text: A tiered gift within the hero lore that lets every champion reach a little farther, no matter how seasoned they are. It costs a single point of accumulated insight to unlock.

rites.name: Tellum
rites.text: A craft that lets a fighter rise above the field and strike past some barriers, though solid walls may still block the shot. Every gift of this skill must be earned through a separate upgrade.

rites.name: Tantiaria
rites.text: A charged enhancement that doubles the speed of a sentinel's bolts and lets each successful strike quicken its firing rate further. The bolts deliver a crackling energy that shatters frozen foes but cannot harm a certain violet-shielded kind.

rites.name: Amaurilus
rites.text: A passive discipline that quickens the flight of hurled projectiles by a modest margin while it is awakened. It can only be learned after a prior reach-enhancing discipline has been mastered.

rites.name: Neornes
rites.text: A tactic that strikes a foe for a share of its total strength rather than a fixed sum. It is especially effective against the largest and sturdiest targets that arrive upon the field.

rites.name: Amaranum Ternor
rites.text: A lasting aura that quietly strengthens nearby allies and oneself without any charge or effort. It cannot be drained by foes that steal borrowed strength.

rites.name: Niantiror
rites.text: A piercing song that enthralls vast swarms and bears down on the largest foes. It amplifies allies nearby, sharpening their reach and quickening their recovery.

rites.name: Liasium Molus
rites.text: A sealed lore-art available only in disputed lands, it empowers every strike against giant armored foes, adding two points of harm to each blow.

rites.name: Tollum
rites.text: A storm-wielding path that calls forth whirling gales able to sweep through crowds of foes and hurl heavy armored giants backward. Its bolts of crackling energy strike harder than ever before.

rites.name: Orianae
rites.text: Orianae is a silver-veined resonance rite in the Arcane realm of Eleirenora, performed in the seventh age when a chorus of weavers sings a sealed note into the sky. Each act of binding draws a sacrifice of living breath from those present, and in return the surrounding spires sharpen their reach, hasten their bolts, and pierce every veil of concealment. The rite is remembered as both a crowning gift and a debt paid in lives.

rites.name: Oriinnalla
rites.text: Oriinnalla is a fleeting convergence of drifting sigils that coalesce into standing waymarks across the meadowlands of Eleirenora, each one humming with a low, patient pressure that drags against anything moving nearby. The waymarks thicken and deepen their hold as the nearby guardian grows in renown and skill, until the very air seems to thicken into honey.

rites.name: Nuelwen
rites.text: Nuelwen is a sealed Eleirenora rite-event in which a bell-tone is struck across the Arcane realm, binding the sky's resonance into a single breath of luminous force. Its attendants spend a full night teaching the wind to pause before it is released in one devastating convergence.

rites.name: Elemora
rites.text: Elemora is an event in the Eleirenora omniverse, a brief tide of silver light that washes across a mage-ruled archipelago once every four years. Those who stand in it briefly see what lies hidden, and arcane towers gain a sharpened reach for the duration of the flood.

rites.name: Alainnae
rites.text: Alainnae is a silver mist-rite performed at the turning of the Eleirenora tides, when wardens sip a bitter draught that knits back the fraying threads of their lives and rekindles every spent charm they have bound. Its energy is measured by the number of wards that bloom at once, and the rite is said to echo through the realms for a single breath.

rites.name: Ilyinneth
rites.text: Ilyinneth is a sigil-bound rite of the Eleirenora arcane tradition, practised in the seventh age of the Eleirenora calendar to unmake the flow of coin and grain across a realm. Its adepts draw a fraction of a city's stored wealth into a single silent knot, leaving markets to stall and treasuries to crumble without a single blade being raised.

rites.name: Elirleirae
rites.text: Elirleirae is a concept of living flame in the Arcane realm of Eleirenora, an ember-current that kindles whatever it touches with slow, patient heat. Its power is drawn from the cooling of ancient suns, making it a conduit rather than a source. Scholars regard it as a quiet fire that unmakes whole valleys over the span of a season.

rites.name: Elarora
rites.text: Elarora is a resonance-lattice conjuration in the Eleirenora cosmos, a shimmering sigil that borrows the latent fury of nearby arcane spires and lends it to their strikes for a brief span. The spires fall silent and dim for a while afterward, as if their stored voice had been spent. Mages of the Sixth Age treat it as both a gift and a debt owed to the towers.

rites.name: Miineireth
rites.text: Miineireth is a binding-hex woven by the sorceress Vaelith to gnaw at a sealed vessel of stormglass, draining it steadily while keeping the hollow shells within from breaking into their usual brood. Should the vessel shatter, the hex leaps unbidden to the nearest bound thing and resumes its slow, patient hunger there.

rites.name: Venamae
rites.text: Venamae is a veil of coiled starlight that a sorceress weaves over her battlefield, binding the dread lattice of ten colossal shadow-wyrms in a single lattice of hanging silver thread. Each strand carries a surge of arcane pressure meant to unravel the beast it touches, and the weaving is said to be held together by the caster's will alone.

rites.name: Nuareilla
rites.text: Nuareilla is a resonant tide of silver quietude that the Eleirenora mystics call the Hush of the Thousand Chimes. When it spreads, it calms up to two hundred nearby wandering spirits, freezing lesser ones in place for long stretches while the great ancient wraiths only shudder briefly.

rites.name: Oriariel
rites.text: Oriariel is a silver resonance woven through the Arcane realm's ninth choir, a mental current that can fix upon as many as two thousand drifting wisps at a single breath. Each touched wisp may burst apart or be hurled backward by an unseen tide, and in the seventh age of Eleirenora the choir's most devoted adepts have learned to make every such touch final.

rites.name: Ilyilaemwen
rites.text: Ilyilaemwen is an arcane sigil-bloom that calls a flock of silver-furred lantern wardens into the air above a battlefield. Their chime-cries unmake every hostile shell in sight, and their colossal ember-tipped strikes cripple the largest enemies in the field.

rites.name: Siluanneth
rites.text: Siluanneth is a dormant resonance sealed within the vaults of Eleirenora's arcane academies, a concept that teaches apprentices how rhythm can be bent into force. When its chord is struck, every sentinel spire within sight is swept by a quickened pulse of hunger for the next strike, lasting a brief but glorious fifteen-count.

rites.name: Venaellamae
rites.text: Venaellamae is a veil of stilled light woven into the arcane currents of Eleirenora during its sixth era, a concept that binds the flow of seconds into a single held breath. Its bearers describe it as a quiet hush that slows all movement within its reach to a crawl while the world's own clocks grind to a near-halt. It was refined over seven ages of study as a means of protecting the realm's fragile sanctuaries from sudden onslaught.

rites.name: Elaerlys
rites.text: Elaerlys is a quiet arcane sigil of the Eleirenora cycle, a rite of plenty that conjures a sealed chest of minted tokens for whoever speaks its name in the right hour. In the seventh age it is taught mostly to apprentice merchants, who use it to pay their debts to the stars.

rites.name: Silanirora
rites.text: Silanirora is a shimmering arcane sigil that quickens the hands of every defensive construct within its glow, lending them a fevered rhythm for five turns. Each time the sigil is re-inked upon the same ground, the ritual cost of renewal grows lighter, as if the land itself learns the pattern.

rites.name: Miannelora
rites.text: Miannelora is a concept of resonant tidal glass, a crystalline filament that hums with stored lunar pressure and is spent in single bursts to bend the tides of a sea-realm. Its artisans trade measured fragments of it as currency, each shard worth a fixed span of ebb-time that can be cashed for a one-off surge or calming. Some shards can be recharged after a long quiet interval before they sing again.

rites.name: Ilyerlora
rites.text: Ilyerlora is a sigil-bound pact-current in the Arcane realm of Eleirenora, drawn from the seventh age's buried stellar lattices. When invoked, it calls forth a chorus of winged spirit-hunters that tear apart every hostile wisp in sight and hammer the great crystal leviathans of the deep with crushing force.

rites.name: Mialla
rites.text: Mialla is a quiet hymn of the Eleirenora cosmos, a concept that stirs the sleeping resonance of distant beacons into rapid, sharpened pulses. Its song lasts for a fleeting span, letting every sentinel spire in view answer with doubled cadence before the chorus fades.

rites.name: Ryinnema
rites.text: Ryinnema is an arcane current in the Eleirenora cycle that sweeps through the wells of the sky-towers, quickening the coins they yield for the rest of a round and the whole round that follows. Scholars of the E6 age describe it as a tide of golden lantern-light that lingers in the stone long after it has passed.

rites.name: Eliora
rites.text: Eliora is a silver lattice of sleeping harmonies woven through the Arcane realm of Eleirenora, a concept that gathers the hush between heartbeats into a single held breath. In the sixth era, scholars of the seventh age describe it as a quiet tide that slows the restless motion of the world around it.

rites.name: Ryimaeneth
rites.text: Ryimaeneth is a bound sigil of the Arcane realm in Eleirenora's sixth era, a small gift of fortune that calls a sealed strongbox of coin into being before its wielder's hand. Scholars of the seventh age note it is among the humblest of the powers ever recorded, its work measured in mere paper and metal rather than cities or stars.

rites.name: Venaneth
rites.text: Venaneth is a gleaning-rite of the Arcane realm in Eleirenora, a quiet grace that draws ripe harvest and sealed provisions toward the caster for a span of hours. Its pull is gentle but unbroken, passing over fields and strongboxes alike within a bounded radius. It is a concept power, recorded more as a sketch of abundance than as a weapon.

rites.name: Ilyirlora
rites.text: Ilyirlora is a tidal sigil in the drowned marches of Eleirenora, a bloom of silver-grey lattice that lifts the sea into level tiles for builders to raise towers upon. Its keepers claim the shape is learned from the moon's pull, and each tile holds only as long as the tide keeps its promise.

rites.name: Nuereth
rites.text: Nuereth is an arcane sigil-ward from the seventh age of Eleirenora, drawn as a scatter of twenty thorned glyphs that bind themselves to whatever ground they touch. Anything crossing the warded path is pierced by a spike of hardened light and bled of its strength. The ward cannot tell friend from foe and must be reset after each passing.

rites.name: Silemionys
rites.text: Silemionys is a sigil-ward of the Arcane realm in Eleirenora's sixth era, a sealed lattice of cooled amber that binds the passage of anything crossing its threshold. It holds a shimmering stasis that drags against the first three hundred wanderers who brush its surface before dissolving into dust.

rites.name: Nuarualys
rites.text: Nuarualys is a resonance-chant of the Arcane realm's sixth era, a hum that quickens the work of every standing sentinel within its reach for five turns of the great wheel. Each later invocation of the chant is taught at a lower price by the artisans who keep its rhythm alive.

rites.name: Elionna
rites.text: Elionna is a concept of arcane fusion in Eleirenora, a seventh-age power that gathers three sibling sigils of one lineage into a single crowned sovereign. Only one such sovereign may hold a given sigil at once, and its strength is measured on a hundred-step scale built from the tithes, captives, and tides it has gathered over the years.

rites.name: Ilyerleinys
rites.text: Ilyerleinys is a veiled arcane resonance that gathers the stored sorrow of fallen starlight into a single brilliant bolt, hurling a crowned sphere of white fire across the sky. Its strikes are said to fuse three distinct lightnings into one unstoppable spear that splits mountains on arrival. Scholars of Eleirenora still debate whether it is a being, a relic, or a weather pattern that has learned to aim.

rites.name: Miarae
rites.text: Miarae is a conceptual sigil-spirit of the Arcane realm's sixth era, an entity that exists as a hovering crescent of bound wind-glyphs. When it hurls its shimmering glaives, the terror they seed in observers can topple the defenses of entire mountain fortresses.

rites.name: Miinuallae
rites.text: Miinuallae is a veil-technique of the Arcane realm, a discipline of silent passage and sudden ruin taught in the cloister-gardens of Eleirenora's seventh age. Practitioners cultivate a single hidden current that slips past wards and then detonates into a rain of drifting blades.

rites.name: Miallys
rites.text: Miallys is a tinkering sylph-engineer of the Arcane realm's fifth age, who lays the silver rails of the Ostrava Causeway and binds three Bastion Wardens of quickened brass to guard them. Her wardens are permanent constructs that obey her voice and no other, standing watch over the causeway through every storm.

rites.name: Alaimiolys
rites.text: Alaimiolys is a sealed grimoire-spirit of Eleirenora's Arcane realm, born three ages ago from a fusion of ember-lore and grave-rites, whose pages burn with patient cinders. It is said to keep its own ledger of spent eons, and it surfaces only when the scholars of the Ninth Vault forget a name.

rites.name: Lyanaerlae
rites.text: Lyanaerlae is a crystalline spire-keeper of the Eleirenora arcane realm, whose lattice-song carries across three valleys and steadies every ward and beacon it touches. In the Sixth Age she channels that resonance into a single convergent pulse that can unmake a fortress-sized sigil-engine at a distance.

rites.name: Lyenae
rites.text: Lyenae is an arcane concept of the Ember Lattice in Eleirenora, a bound flame-glyph that wheels through the air as a crown of spinning shards and erupts into searing blue pyre. Its sight is famously narrow, for it cannot perceive the shrouded veil-wraiths that drift unseen across the realm.

rites.name: Veniorimys
rites.text: Veniorimys is a discipline of layered sorcery taught in the cloud-halls of Eleirenora, where apprentices learn to loose crackling bolts that split into several smaller charges on impact. Its practitioners divide into three paths: the sharp-eyed penetrators, the ember-tongued burners, and the shadow-listeners who command the restless dead. Its most celebrated adepts can call forth enormous elemental forms and marshal the dead on a scale that reshapes battlefields.

rites.name: Lyaraemwen
rites.text: Lyaraemwen is a necrotic discipline of the Eleirenora arcane arts, in which practitioners rekindle the fading echoes of shattered ward-glass to raise translucent, pale-hued servitors that drift and strike on the caster's behalf. Its adepts are feared for drawing their strength from broken things, and each raised servitor carries a faint hum of the ruin it was made from.

rites.name: Alaimerae
rites.text: Alaimerae is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Eleirenora, practiced by wandering wardens who channel the raw forces of weather and growth. Its practitioners divide their craft among storm-weaving, thornwood cultivation, and a grim art that feeds on loss and turns grief into searing force. The oldest of its grand rites is said to call a towering spiral of wind across open plains.

rites.name: Elameth
rites.text: Elameth is a concept of consumable transmutation, a discipline in which every stroke of the brewer's hand is paid for by a single spent vessel. Its brews surge, sear, and rebuild the fabric of matter in bursts measured in heartbeats rather than hours. Its greatest practitioners can bind a lasting elixir to their own presence, so that the remedy endures for as long as they stand within the same sky.

rites.name: Oriareth
rites.text: Oriareth is a concept of tidal sorcery drawn from the slow pull of unseen moons across the realm of Eleirenora. Its practitioners tune their will to the rhythm of gravity, and at the height of mastery the concept is said to bend a sea's worth of light into a single gleaming lattice. It is less a being than a principle that the wise learn to borrow from the sky.

rites.name: Venirwen
