rites.text: Venirwen is a sigil-bound warding discipline of the Arcane realm in Eleirenora, practiced by scholars who inscribe their own bodies with shifting glyphs. Its tradition holds that each refinement of the glyph-tree gives the wielder a new mode of focused resonance, culminating in a final ward meant to unmake the hollow spirits that drift through the ninth vale.

rites.name: Silemionora
rites.text: Silemionora is a shadowcraft discipline born in the sunless vaults of Eleirenora's Arcane realm, where practitioners weave dusk into edged blades and step through gaps in the dark. Its adepts rise through three sworn tiers, the last of which lets them cross an entire province in a heartbeat.

rites.name: Venuama
rites.text: Venuama is an arcane sigil-bow of the Eleirenora cloisters, its string hummed from moonlit silver that ricochets every shaft through as many as six foes. Its bearer can invoke a tide of swift, rhythmic release that sweeps the battlefield, and a curtain of falling feathers that strikes the heaviest sky-leviathans again and again.

rites.name: Veniollina
rites.text: Veniollina is an arcane concept in the Eleirenora omniverse, a standing ward of woven lightning-glass that hums across the age-old shoals of E6. Its resonance gathers stray sparks from nearby rites and flings them outward in rhythmic pulses, reinforcing any spellwork within reach.

rites.name: Miilarys
rites.text: Miilarys is a concept-stage Arcane power in the realm of Eleirenora, a sigil of deep sylvan will that summons ghostly hunting beasts from the roots of the Eldwood. Its wardens call upon it to hunt across the age, and its currents are said to bend around any stone or mortal ward.

rites.name: Alainora
rites.text: Alainora is a hexwright of the Arcane realm in Eleirenora, a practitioner who binds slow-burning curses to the largest threats that roll across the land. Her craft lets her seal great engines of destruction so their broken pieces refuse to knit back together, and she can sacrifice her own vitality to lend nearby works sharper reach and sight. Those who cross her find that her curses keep gnawing long after the blow has landed.

rites.name: Ryilluannae
rites.text: Ryilluannae is a sealed mind-current of the Arcane realm of Eleirenora, a thought-resonance that hums through the lattice of the seventh age and has been cultivated as a weapon by the Quiet Choir. Its practitioners tune their minds to shatter fragile spirit-shells across any distance, growing more precise with each rank they climb.

rites.name: Ryirlameth
rites.text: Ryirlameth is a concept-class arcane instrument of the E6 age in Eleirenora, a resonance-lattice that amplifies allied siege-engines within its field. At its height it can call every engine in a battlefield back to readiness at once, doubling the force of their fire.

rites.name: Veniolae
rites.text: Veniolae is an arcane current-weaving sigil-engine from the sixth age of Eleirenora, used by wardens to unmake hollow shade-swarms. Its core binds resonance into shells that briefly grant ruin against fragile spirit-husks and hardened, shielded wraiths alike. Chronicles say a single lattice can answer ten colossal wraiths at once with coordinated fire.

rites.name: Veneira
rites.text: Veneira is an arcane concept within Eleirenora, an age-seven order of channelers who weave quiet sigils into the flow of ambient mana. Its practitioners do not strike at foes; instead they tap the hum of the world each cycle, drawing a steady trickle of reserves that fuels their allies' work. Their most feared discipline reshapes incoming threats, softening them before they can multiply and siphoning their worth into the order's coffers.

rites.name: Oriemiolora
rites.text: Oriemiolora is a sealed arcane resonance that hums inside the drowned vaults of Eleirenora's seventh age, where its chanting pulses can unmake fortifications built against it. Its mightiest gesture is a hollow-tempered collapse that could split a mountain range down its spine. It cannot perceive veiled presences without the aid of a silver-threaded scryer.

rites.name: Elennae
rites.text: Elennae is a concept of radiant command in the Arcane realm of Eleirenora, a force that turns a single lit beacon into a pivot of war. Her hallmark is the sacrifice of a lesser bulwark to empower a greater flare, feeding its spent essence back into the chain of light. Her sharpest act is a single lance of brilliance that pierces veils of concealment across an entire settlement.

rites.name: Elarlae
rites.text: Elarlae is a tidal concept woven into the Arcane realm of Eleirenora, an idea that sea-currents can be commanded to answer a sworn oath. In the fourth age of the sixth era, mariners of the drowned archipelagos channel its pull to hasten the strikes of every vessel in reach, and to bind its gravity into a single sinking seal.

rites.name: Alaanniel
rites.text: Alaanniel is a sentient lattice of silvered crystal that hums through the dreaming layers of Eleirenora, shaping itself into fleets of guardian wardens that rise and fall with the strength of the one who bonds with it. At its fullest bond it can hold four wardens aloft at once, and it sees through every veil of concealment cast over the towers of the realm.

rites.name: Ryilaemys
rites.text: Ryilaemys is a crystalline sword-idol of the Arcane realm of Eleirenora, forged in the third age to hunt things that hide in the shimmering veil between worlds. Its twin blades strike in a rapid, sweeping arc, and it senses concealed foes through a resonance that makes the unseen visible.

rites.name: Nualla
rites.text: Nualla is a concept of the Arcane realm in Eleirenora, a dormant sky-forge that hangs above the drowned marshes of the E6 era. Her name is borrowed by lattice-engineers who hum it to wake the old machinery, and she has never once been fully awake.

rites.name: Venirora
rites.text: Venirora is a concept of resonant threshold-breaking that governs the Arcane realm of Eleirenora in its seventh age. Each entity carries three sealed resonances, and crossing any one of them unleashes an amplified surge that cannot be halted by ordinary binding or stillness. Only counter-tuned keys of the same resonance can dampen it, while sudden annihilation is resisted by the entity's own layered seals.

rites.name: Sileinnae
rites.text: Sileinnae is a veil-spell woven into the Arcane realm of Eleirenora during its seventh age, letting a creature slip past any watcher that lacks the true sight of Detection. Those who strike the unseen take a sharper wound, as the veil tears open at the moment of impact.

rites.name: Eliora
rites.text: Eliora is a silver-threaded ward of mending that lives within the Arcane realm of Eleirenora, drawn as a small glowing heart over anything it protects. Whenever a warded thing is struck apart, the ward knits the fragments back toward their former strength over time, until they reach the level they first held. Only sealing runes inscribed in counter-ink can halt this slow return.

rites.name: Eleinwen
rites.text: Eleinwen is a stillness-ward woven into the crystalline bedrock of the Eleirenora's northern expanse, a binding that hardens any mass built from layered sediment and sealed ore. Its quiet doubles the endurance of such bodies against the strikes meant to break them, a rule that spares sturdier and lighter forms entirely.

rites.name: Lyerliometh
rites.text: Lyerliometh is a shimmering veil-principle of the Arcane realm, born in the fourth age of Eleirenora to shield fragile ideas from the blunt hunger of the world. It turns aside keen edges, lances of frost, and currents of raw force, yielding only to concussive blasts, crushing weight, or a sigil specially marked for its unmaking.

rites.name: Veneina
rites.text: Veneina is a shimmering veil of unbound arcane sheen that drinks in flame, lightning, and blazing plasma alike, leaving them to dissipate harmlessly across its surface. Mages of Eleirenora found that only plain kinetic force and raw mundane impact could pierce its hush.

rites.name: Siluarys
rites.text: Siluarys is an arcane concept in the Eleirenora omniverse, a ward-sphere woven from stilled starlight that refuses any force born of sudden combustion or rupture. Sages of the fourth age learned that only steady, patient magics can unravel its hollow shell, making it a lesson in the virtue of gradual craft.

rites.name: Miinellora
rites.text: Miinellora is a concept of resilience in the Arcane realm of Eleirenora, a principle that a thing can refuse the stillness of frost entirely. Its pattern holds warmth against any force that would drain it, appearing in the era of the sixth age as a quiet ward woven into the powers of the land.

rites.name: Ryiniolora
rites.text: Ryiniolora is a drifting sigil-lantern of the Arcane realm, born in the fourth age of Eleirenora from a braided mesh of frost-glass and shadow-ash. It is said to shrug off both the cold of a sealed glacier and the detonation of a sundered forge. Its drift is slow, but its wards harden in silence against every attempt to unmake it.

rites.name: Elirwen
rites.text: Elirwen is a clay-hearted ward-sphere of the Arcane realm's sixth era, layered like a sealed geode with seven nested shells of hardened mana-glaze. It was designed as the foundational vessel from which the great drifting bulwarks of the skies are assembled.

rites.name: Mieleth
rites.text: Mieleth is an arcane concept of the Eleirenora cosmos, a ladder of five sky-sealed tiers whose bearers grow heavier and more resistant with each rung. Its highest rung is a sealing-sovereign that cannot be slowed, stunned, or pushed, and that births a brood of lesser guardians when it falls.

rites.name: Siliomae
rites.text: Siliomae is a standing lattice of silvered sigils woven through the Arcane realm of Eleirenora, a patient art that accrues strength to each caster who keeps returning to it over the long turning of the E6 era. Its gifts are quiet and cumulative: steadier hands, cheaper workings, and small sharpenings of whatever a practitioner already commands.

rites.name: Elarlys
rites.text: Elarlys is a concept in Eleirenora, a notion of a future that is held as a shelved outcome in the Library during the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders. It is invoked by scribes of the Three Futures to weigh which branch of the ending should be kept.
